we have designed and implemented a novel fully digital MIMO PWA function computing architecture that is able to handle regular hyperrectangular, simplicial, and lattice PWA representations, using a common architecture and a minimized number of hardware blocks, thus reducing significantly the hardware resources and power consumption.

(1) the proposed architecture is able, with a reduced number of blocks, to implement PWA function following different realization strategies; (2) the proposed architecture can be used to implement PWA models with regular hyperrectangular partitions, simplicial partitions and lattice PWA representations; and (3) the proposed architecture has been compared to other digital architecture in the state of art, habitually used to implemented model predictive control applications, being better in power consumption and hardware cost than others.
